name: NeuS with Depth-Guided Hierarchical Sampling and Modulated Variance
definition: A neural rendering method that renders volumetric alpha from a signed distance field (SDF) using a learnable inverse temperature (variance) parameter, with hierarchical ray sampling guided by predicted depth from a 3DGS branch.
summary: NeuS with Depth-Guided Hierarchical Sampling and Modulated Variance is a neural rendering method that uses 3D Gaussian Splatting depth to guide adaptive ray sampling, concentrating points near surfaces to reduce empty-space queries.
